hypothesis: Check whether the Neumann representations remain numerically valid and useful in 3D before any default promotion. This is a short screen, not multi-seed acceptance.
derivative_rule: ordinary autograd for all representations; no analytic prototype in this screen
fixed_settings: Current Torch2.1/cu118 RTX4070Ti FP32 TF32off; hard_initial_robin; recursive; auto background; backward parameters; identity robin_grouped and feature eager; one fresh process per trial; global GPU lock after pullback006.
measurements: Independent global/final/PDE/mode errors and face operators, train/prediction/process time, counters, peak allocated/reserved memory, hashes and parameter count.
scope: Record all finite failures against absolute thresholds. No tuning or default promotion from one seed. 3D support tests are not proof of accurate training; this screen adds actual solutions.
storage: Compact final/snapshot CSV; raw temporal profiles and weights remain Windows.
